## Public projects

- [CSV Reporting Example](https://wtfashwin.github.io/Portfolio/reporting-example/): A synthetic campaign report from two fictional CSV files. [Source code](https://github.com/wtfashwin/csv-report-pilot). Synthetic example using fictional CSV inputs; no upload, live connector, customer results or production reporting service is established.
- [Customer Support System](https://github.com/wtfashwin/Customer-Support-System): AI support workflows and retrieval. Public implementation; deployment and production outcomes are not asserted. Evidence checked 2026-10-27; [source commit 60f711e7d2bec62a0fcc9bf48515027965f071ef](https://github.com/wtfashwin/Customer-Support-System/tree/60f711e7d2bec62a0fcc9bf48515027965f071ef). GitHub Actions passed on 14 Oct 2026: web/API builds and checks, fresh and repeated PostgreSQL 16 setup, Python tests, and dry fixture evaluation. Deployment, external-provider, authentication and live RAG paths remain unverified.
- [Context Dock](https://github.com/wtfashwin/ContextDock): Native macOS developer tool. Public implementation; deployment and production outcomes are not asserted. Evidence checked 2026-10-27; [source commit f20c8fb871f1a89685ffc6e3222dcc14a9eec061](https://github.com/wtfashwin/ContextDock/tree/f20c8fb871f1a89685ffc6e3222dcc14a9eec061). GitHub Actions passed shell checks, package build and tests on 14 Oct 2026 at this pull-request commit. These checks do not establish native UI behavior, external CLI compatibility or end-user runtime outcomes.
- [Fraud Detection](https://github.com/wtfashwin/fraud-detection): Credit-card feature scoring and asynchronous explanations. Public implementation; deployment and production outcomes are not asserted.

## Selected accepted upstream changes

Checked 2026-10-12: 11 visible merged PRs across seven upstream repositories. The 7 selected records below are a subset. This is not a lifetime census or a claim of endorsement.

- [PrefectHQ/prefect #22035](https://github.com/PrefectHQ/prefect/pull/22035): Allow cached task results in Azure Blob Storage to be overwritten on reruns.
- [dlt-hub/dlt #3947](https://github.com/dlt-hub/dlt/pull/3947): Load Parquet row groups individually to limit SQL Server ingestion memory.
- [VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics #10974](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/pull/10974): Stop integrate() from adding data beyond the end of a metric series.
- [unslothai/unsloth #5551](https://github.com/unslothai/unsloth/pull/5551): Release a stuck IME typing state so users can send their messages.
- [langfuse/langfuse-python #1664](https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse-python/pull/1664): Support installation with wrapt 2.x.
- [TracecatHQ/tracecat #2715](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/2715): Request only the Elastic alert fields a workflow needs.
- [ParisNeo/lollms-webui #690](https://github.com/ParisNeo/lollms-webui/pull/690): Clarify path sanitization and add traversal regression tests.
